modules.name: GENRA TECHNO
modules.description: A generative sequencer for techno and club music: 22 styles in 8 families (Detroit, Berlin, Acid, Hard, Melodic, House, Trance, Electro), five tracks (drums, bass, stab, lead, atmo), a whole song made live (intro, groove, build, drop, break, outro) with ten kinds of build, PERFORM keys, energy and evolve

modules.name: GENRA TECHNO GRID
modules.description: The editor of GENRA TECHNO: drum raster and piano roll, velocity, chance and ratchets per step, an own loop length per track (polymeter), REC from MIDI

modules.name: GENRA TECHNO ABLAUF
modules.description: The song arranger of GENRA TECHNO: 64 pattern pads, variations per part, a song list in 8 to 64 bar rows, MAKE SONG in club forms (DJ intro and outro), song MIDI export

modules.name: GENRA TECHNO MOD
modules.description: Four CV lanes that move with the song: one movement per part and lane (rise, swell, wave, pump, wander, jump, dip …), depth, smooth, GROW for later drops, a song view
